body.x: Cobra (https://www.cobra.com), the leading designer and marketer of award-winning automotive, mobile, outdoor and consumer electronics, unveiled Radar Detection Systems, Drive HD Dash Cams and other consumer electronics products and accessories at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.

Radar Detection Systems nearly doubles the detection range and warning time of previous models and uses the latest technology, military grade components and best design practices to pack extraordinary performance into a sleek detector nearly half the size of other detectors on the market.
Drive HD Dash Cams records everything drivers see in full 1296P Super HD or 1080P HD video.
